name: PHIL 5325
title: Topics in Africana Philosophy
description: Philosophical problems from across African American philosophy, Afro-Caribbean philosophy, and African philosophy, examined using approaches from Africana analytical, dialectical, existential, feminist, phenomenological, and pragmatist thought. May include a historical focus on ideas from ancient African philosophy. May be repeated for up to nine credits with change in content. May be repeated for a total of 9 credits.
requirement_description: Open to graduate students in Philosophy and to others with permission.
